(759)༄༅/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mthing dkar gnyis kyi mnga' gsol dge legs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ //

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (759)༄༅// myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po mthing dkar gnyis kyi mnga' gsol dge legs sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs so// /

(760)༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ ye shes mgon po rdo rje phyag drug pa la mnga' gsol dbul bar 'dod pas rgyan gyis spras pa'i gtor chen dang sman phud sogs mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba bshams la byin gyis brlab pa ni/ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du a las thod pa mtshan ldan yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bruṃ āṃḥdz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐ rnams las sha lnga/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ pāṃ rnams las bdud rtsi lnga/ steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po/ a las zla ba/ hūm̐ las rdo rje rnams brtsegs pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu/ yig 'bru gsum las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs thim/ oṃ dang zla ba rdo rje rnams kyang 'od du zhu zhing thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa dang*/ rten skong sgrub cing mchod pa'i dam rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ dbyangs rol bcas/ /hūm̐/ bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// chos dbyings rnam dag ngang las (761)ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa// myur mdzad mgon po 'dir gshegs mchod gsol bzhes// ye shes bskal pa'i me yi klong dkyil na// thabs la mkhas pas rab khros skur ston pa// mi bsrun bdud sde 'joms pa'i dpa' bo che// myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang mnga' gsol lo// rtag tu 'gro la khyab pa'i thugs rje yis// rab tu zhi yang mchog tu gtum pa'i sku// dus mtha'i sprin dang mig sman ltar gnag pa// 'jigs byed khrag 'thung gtso bo mnga' gsol lo// rab bzhad rdo rje'i gad mo chen po yis// bdud dang gshin rje'i snying 'gas klad pa 'gems// lha dang lha min ma rungs sder bcas ltung*// drag shul bzod dka'i gtso bor mnga' gsol lo// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs rgyal rnams kyi// brtse chen gcig tu bsdus pa spyan ras gzigs// dngos grub kun stsol byin rlabs mgon po mchog

/phrin las myur du sgrub mdzad mnga' gsol lo// zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum me ltar 'bar// sma ra smin ma dbu skra gyen du brdzes// klu chen brgyad dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan// phyag drug ye shes mgon po mnga' gsol lo// rin chen cod pan khrag (762)'dzag mgo phreng can// phyag g.yas gri gug thod phreng cang te 'khrol// phyag g.yon thod pa rtse gsum zhags pa bsnams// stag lpags na bzas mdzes pa mnga' gsol lo// mnyam dang g.yon brkyang gyad kyi dor stabs sogs// sna tshogs gar gyis log 'dren steng na rol// pad nyi'i gdan bzhugs tsan+dan ljon pa'i drung*// brten mdzad ma hā kā lar mnga' gsol lo// zhabs sen cung zad brdabs pas sa gzhi g.yo// hūm̐ sgras ri bo ral zhing chu gter 'khrugs// spyan tsam bskyod pas bar chad thams cad sel// thogs med mthu stobs mnga' ba mnga' gsol lo// sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma rin po che// bar chad srung phyir chos spyod bka' sdod sku// sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad pa'i// bla ma mgon po dbyer med mnga' gsol lo// rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo sgrib kun sbyong*// nyid kyi dpral bar brten pa'i chos 'byung dbyibs// sin+dhu ra'i thig ler yum gcig rnal 'byor ma// 'khor 'das chos kun skyed mar mnga' gsol lo// de dbus hrīḥyig dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon// khams gsum dbang sgyur mkha' 'gro ma rnams spro// 'gugs byed bcu gsum yig 'bru'i gsang sngags mchog /'phags ma sgrol ma'i ngo bor mnga' gsol lo// mi bskyod dbang phyug rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs// bcom ldan gshin rje gshed kyis mthu stobs sbyin// khyod la phyag 'tshal snying nas skyabs su mchi// rtag tu gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten skong sgrub pa'i rdzas// sman rag gtor tshogs mchod pa'i yo byad ni// dngos 'byor yid sprul 'jig rten khams gang bas// ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas mnga' gsol lo// sgrub la bar chad med par byin gyis rlobs// chos kun sgyu mar rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam rang grol 'char bar=

/gtum mo'i bde chen 'char bar= /'od gsal phyag chen rtogs par= /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par= /bar do'i 'jigs pa sel bar= (763)bar dor longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs// 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi bar= /mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub par= /thugs yid gnyis su med par= /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma dang*// dbyer med mgon por mnga' gsol lo// spyan ras gzigs dbang ngo bo'i phyir// yi dam mchog tu mnga'= /sku bzhi mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir// rdzogs sangs rgyas su mnga'= /theg chen dam chos thams cad kyi// mnga' bdag chen por mnga'= /'phags tshogs dge 'dun thams cad kyi// gtso bo chen por mnga'= /thub dbang bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// chos skyong chen por= /lha chen rnams kyi gtso bo'i phyir// legs ldan chen por= /drag po'i las la dbang mdzad phyir// nag po chen por= /gsang sngags rig 'dzin thams cad kyi// srung ma chen por= /rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan rnams kyi// dgra lha chen por= /bdag cag 'khor bcas thams cad kyi// mgon dang skyabs su mnga' gsol lo// thub pa'i dbang po'i bstan pa srungs// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod// 'gal rkyen zlog cing mthun rkyen sgrubs// mnga' gsol don dang ldan par mdzod// dpal myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la gsol lo mchod do// rdo rje nag po chen po dpal he ru ka dang rang bzhin chos nyid kyi ngang du gcig cing ngo bo ye shes su mtshungs pa/ mtshan nyid phrin las phyogs med du mnyam pa/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i dpa' bo/ snang srid lha 'dre kun gyi yongs rje/ zhing skyong drag po'i bka' nyan gyi sde dpon/ mi pham rdo rje gzi brjid kyi rgyal po// rig 'dzin gyi dbang phyug bu bzhin du skyong ba/ dam can sgrub pa po'i bsam gtan gyi drod nyul ba/

zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ rgyas pa'i byin chags pa/ dbang sdud las kyi rtsal mnga' ba/ drag pos dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i las la myur ba/ bstan pa srung ba'i rtsal (764)'byin pa/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug zhing skyong rdo rje nag po phyag drug pa/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la/ gshin rje ṭā ki rā dza/ dbang phyug dzi na mi tra/ bdud mgon trak+shad nag po/ phyogs skyong chen po bcu/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsol lo// mchod do// mnga' gsol lo// mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub dang bde ba chen po'i zhing khams su bgrod pa'i lam gyi bar chad dang*/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad las bsgral ba'i lam gyi skyel ma dam pa mdzod cig /yang dag pa'i lam dang 'phrad pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sun ma dang sprad par mdzod cig /byang chub ma thob kyi bar du yang lus ngag yid gsum log pa'i lam du mi 'gro zhing*/ thar pa byang chub kyi lam du blo 'gro bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog thun mongs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi dpal dang mgon du 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du phrin las bzhi'i bya ba thams cad la ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i don thams cad de kho na nyid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib 'jigs pa brgyad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags longs spyod sogs 'byor pa drug spel bar mdzad du gsol/ khams gsum gyi lha 'dre mi gsum mos bzhis dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra gdon bgegs tshogs byad phur rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi nas tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol/ mdor na skye ba kun tu thugs rjes yud tsam yang mi 'dor bar don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

/mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu la mnga' gsol 'bul bar spro na/ gtor ma phud mchod gtsang zhing dag la rgya che ba 'du byas la/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i (765)ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me'i steng du āḥlas ka pā la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba hūm̐ bh+rūṃ oṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan drangs te thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs la/ /hūm̐/ mgon po yid bzhin nor bu thugs rje can// sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar 'od zer 'phro// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs ma lus zhi mdzad pa// 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol 'dir gshegs mchod gsol bzhes// lhun stug kai lā sha yi ri bo ltar// 'od zer bye bas 'khyud pa'i rdul phreng can// dbang sdud mkha' 'gro stong gi bdag po ni// myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang mnga' gsol lo// 'dzum bag brjid pa'i zhal ras yid tsam khro/ 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal po khyod// chos nyid thig le'i sgo ngar gdod ma'i sems// mngon gyur ye shes sku can mnga' gsol lo// dngul chu'i mdangs gsal hūm̐ yig las 'khrungs pa// skye 'gro'i re skong dbul ba'i sdug bsngal sel// dbu skra gyen brdzes spyi bor mi 'khrugs rgyal// rgyas gdab dbang bskur che brnyes mnga' gsol lo// kha ba'i ri la 'char ka gsar ba ltar// khyod zhal smin mtshams sin+dhu'i thig le mdzes// rin chen gdu bu 'khrol ba'i phyag drug po// bla med phar phyin ngo bor mnga' gsol lo// gri gug yid bzhin nor bu ḍā ma ru// nor bus gtams pa'i thod pa bum par bcas// rtse gsum dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bsnams// phyag drug ye shes mgon por mnga' gsol lo// lhab lhub dar dang stag lpags na bza' can// 'od 'bar rin chen rgyan gyi sil khrol dang*// nor bu'i chun 'phyangs du mas rab tu mdzes// gzi byin lhang nger 'bar ba mnga' gsol lo// 'dod pa'i (766)longs spyod char chen 'bebs byed pa// bi na ya ka'i steng na rol pas bzhugs// rab sngo tsan+dan ljon pa'i tshal na dgyes// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bdag po mnga' gsol lo// thugs kar dbang gi lha mo lang tsho ma// 'char ka'i 'od ris gsar pa glog phreng ltar// mdzes shing g.yo ba'i dngos grub lcags kyu 'dzin// srid gsum dbang du sdud mdzad mnga' gsol lo// mnga' gsol bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*// snying nas lha mchog khyod la gdung ba yis// mnga' gsol 'bul gyis bdag la mchog stsol nas// dpal dang 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod// thugs rje'i sprin las dge legs char phab ste// 'dod dgu'i rba rlabs phreng ba chil chil g.yo// zas nor longs spyod dge legs yar 'phel gyi// dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gong nas gong 'phel shog

/gsol lo mchod do// myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po yid bzhin nor bu/ dran pa tsam gyis 'di phyi bar do'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis 'dod rgu'i dngos grub char bzhin tu 'bebs pa/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag sa dang bar snang nam mkha' gang ba bla ma mgon po dbyer med chos nyid bde ba chen po la yid ches mos gus rtse gcig tu bsgom pa'i mchod sprin bla na med pas dgyes shing mnyes nas/ bdag sgrub pa po la bu gcig pa'i ma bzhin du brtse ba chen pos byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rtag tu mi 'bral bar gzigs la/ gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang dbang phyug zas nor longs spyod snyan grags mnga' thang la sogs pa rab tu 'phel zhing rgyas la nyams pa med pa dang*/ khams gsum srid gsum brten g.yo'i dwangs bcud thams cad thogs pa med (767)par dbang du 'du ba'i mchog sbyin par mdzad du gsol/ mthar thug bde ba can gyi zhing khams su lam sna 'dren pa'i ded dpon dang 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i skyel ma mdzad cing 'jig rten mgon po thugs rje'i dbang phyug gi go 'phang bde blag tu 'thob par byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor mchod nam mkhar 'bul bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni sgar bsang chen mo sogs dus kyi mchod pa'i skabs su 'jug 'os par mthong nas/ jo nang rje btsun chen po sogs byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i gsung rnams gung spros te mnga' gsol ba'i tshig mtha' bsgyur zhing 'don bde bar bsdebs pa ste/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khrod badz+ra ko ṭī ye shes mgon po nyid dgyes rgur rol pa'i dga' ba'i tshal du bris pa dge legs 'phel/// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu//
